_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by eye from the figures. 1: a few plain shapes swap sides; 2: a short word or number, or shapes and arrows; 3: a mix of letters, digits and shapes, or many parts; 4: a long string of small mixed characters, or a clock face. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
